plugins.name: cowork-memory-sync
plugins.description: Share Cowork space conversations across your machines AND across people, via a cloud-synced folder (OneDrive, iCloud, Dropbox, SharePoint/Teams, Box). Snapshot a conversation on one machine, catch up on it from another — or from a collaborator's machine. Spaces are solo (your machines only) or shared (multiple people), switchable either way, with a confirm-before-push review gate on shared spaces. Requires Claude Cowork. No daemon, no MCP, no GitHub.
